# Shared state-file cases: SFTEST|file|expected status|trades|continuation lines[|core lines (6f PCORE)].
# The valid files were written by nnfx_ref/recovery.state_file_text (checksum: FNV-1a 32-bit, checked against
# its published test vectors in test_recovery.py); each corrupt file is a valid one with one change:
# a changed digit (0.0011 -> 0.0012), the last 30 bytes cut off, or the version 1 -> 2 with a re-computed checksum.
SFTEST|valid_two_trades.txt|present|2|2
SFTEST|valid_flat.txt|present|0|1
SFTEST|corrupt_changed_byte.txt|corrupt|0|0
SFTEST|corrupt_truncated.txt|corrupt|0|0
SFTEST|corrupt_wrong_version.txt|corrupt|0|0
# 6f: valid_flat.txt plus two PCORE lines (rules-core memory, DESIGN_6F section 5), and the same with one
# PCORE field dropped and the checksum re-computed (an unreadable line).
SFTEST|valid_with_cores.txt|present|0|1|2
SFTEST|corrupt_core_short.txt|corrupt|0|0|0
